decisions.briefing: Market is strongly risk-on today (NASDAQ +2.2%, S&P 500 +1.7%), and existing holdings should be left alone to run per prior lessons. No new buys today because available cash ($89.29) is far below the $500 threshold needed to open a meaningful new position, even though 3 slots are open.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices rallied sharply today, with the NASDAQ outperforming the S&P 500, suggesting strength concentrated in growth and tech-oriented names. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this reflects the price action data only rather than a confirmed catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤明顯上漲，納斯達克指數升幅超過標普500指數，反映資金傾向流入科技及成長型股份。由於今日未提供具體新聞標題，此總結僅根據價格走勢數據，未能確認明確的市場催化因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Even when the market is rallying and you have open slots in your portfolio, you can't act on new opportunities if your cash balance is too small to fund a meaningful position. Keeping a reasonable cash buffer (or trimming a position) ensures you can actually deploy capital when good setups appear.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使市場上漲、投資組合仍有空位，如果現金水平太低，也無法把握新的入市機會。保持一定的現金儲備（或適時減持部分持股），才能確保有能力在出現好機會時真正投入資金。
